findings.issue: Reaction routes have no workspace/channel membership check
findings.impact: Any authenticated user can read/add/remove reactions on any message across any workspace
findings.fix: Add requireChannelAccess middleware to GET/POST/DELETE /messages/:id/reactions and GET /reactions/batch

findings.issue: Feature-flag routes have broken middleware — requireWorkspaceMembership("workspaceId") on paths without :workspaceId param
findings.impact: All feature-flag requests will fail with 400 "Missing workspaceId" — feature flags are non-functional
findings.fix: Remove requireWorkspaceMembership from feature-flag routes or add workspaceId as a query/body parameter

findings.issue: Message search uses getSupabase() (anon client) instead of req.supabase (JWT client)
findings.impact: auth.uid() is NULL in SECURITY INVOKER search function — cross-tenant search possible or no results returned
findings.fix: Replace getSupabase() with req.supabase in messages/routes.ts line 38

findings.issue: No Socket.io connection state recovery — clients lose all room state on disconnect
findings.impact: After reconnect, clients must manually re-join rooms and re-fetch state; messages may be lost during disconnect window
findings.fix: Enable connectionStateRecovery in Socket.io server config; implement room membership persistence

findings.issue: No per-event authorization after initial Socket.io auth handshake
findings.impact: Any connected client can join any channel room by emitting channel:join with any channelId
findings.fix: Add per-event membership check in channel:join handler before adding socket to room

findings.issue: In-memory idempotency fallback has no size limit or eviction policy
findings.impact: Unbounded memory growth under high request volume — potential OOM
findings.fix: Add Map size limit with LRU eviction to in-memory fallback

findings.issue: GET /webhooks reads workspace_id from query param but middleware checks req.params — workspace validation broken
findings.impact: Webhook listing bypasses workspace membership check
findings.fix: Create a middleware that reads from req.query.workspace_id instead of req.params.workspaceId

findings.issue: Message upload endpoint has no channel/workspace membership check
findings.impact: Any authenticated user can upload files without channel context
findings.fix: Add channel_id to upload payload and requireChannelAccess middleware

findings.issue: Workspace member list returns email field — PII exposure
findings.impact: Workspace members can see each other's email addresses unnecessarily
findings.fix: Remove email from SELECT query in getMembers(), return only display_name and avatar_url

findings.issue: Channel slug dedup loop has no max attempt safety limit
findings.impact: Infinite loop if all slug variants are taken — potential hang/DoS
findings.fix: Add MAX_ATTEMPTS=100 guard similar to workspace slug dedup

findings.issue: Cursor pagination has no input validation — malformed cursor could cause unexpected query behavior
findings.impact: Malformed cursor could lead to SQL injection-like behavior via .or() filter
findings.fix: Validate cursor format (two parts separated by |) before using in query

findings.issue: Uses console.error instead of structured logger.error for push notification failures
findings.impact: Push notification failures not captured in structured logging; harder to alert/diagnose
findings.fix: Replace console.error with logger.error

findings.issue: Consent routes use lowercase error.message format inconsistent with uppercase error.code convention
findings.impact: Inconsistent API contract — clients must handle two error formats
findings.fix: Standardize consent error responses to use error.code uppercase convention

findings.issue: Idempotency-Key header has no format validation
findings.impact: Any string accepted — potential abuse with very long keys
findings.fix: Add UUID or length validation for idempotency-key header

findings.issue: No backup strategy for Supabase Storage files (chat-uploads bucket — avatars and file uploads)
findings.impact: All user-uploaded content (avatars, shared files) has zero backup — complete data loss if storage bucket is corrupted or deleted
findings.fix: Create script to export Supabase Storage bucket to DO Spaces or S3 on a schedule; document restore procedure

findings.issue: No restore test evidence exists — no documented restore drill procedure, no scripts, no evidence of any restore being tested
findings.impact: Backup may be non-functional or incomplete; first restore attempt will be during a real outage
findings.fix: Write and execute a quarterly restore drill; document procedure; create restore script

findings.issue: RTO (Recovery Time Objective) and RPO (Recovery Point Objective) not defined anywhere in the codebase
findings.impact: No recovery expectations documented — operators cannot determine if recovery is 'fast enough'
findings.fix: Define RTO (e.g., 4 hours) and RPO (e.g., 1 hour) based on business requirements; document in runbook

findings.issue: No dedicated backup runbook in docs/runbooks/ — Supabase PITR mentioned only in passing in migration runbook
findings.impact: Operators lack step-by-step backup/restore guidance during incident
findings.fix: Create docs/runbooks/backup-restore.md with: Supabase PITR procedure, storage bucket export, full DR (droplet loss) recovery

findings.issue: No automated Supabase backup verification — no script to check that daily Supabase backup completed successfully
findings.impact: Backup failures go unnoticed until restore is attempted — worst-case: no valid backup exists
findings.fix: Add daily cron job or GitHub scheduled workflow to check Supabase backup status via API

findings.issue: No pg_dump or Supabase export scripts exist — only relies on Supabase managed backups
findings.impact: No offline backup available if Supabase service is unavailable
findings.fix: Add scripts/pg_dump.sh or scripts/export-supabase.sh for on-demand or scheduled export

findings.issue: No full disaster recovery runbook covering total droplet loss scenario
findings.impact: If the DO droplet is lost, operators must reconstruct recovery steps from multiple scattered documents
findings.fix: Create full DR runbook: Terraform init -> apply -> restore DB via PITR -> restore storage -> smoke test

findings.issue: Docker HEALTHCHECK succeeded but no application-level smoke test after restore
findings.impact: Restore can pass health check while critical features are still broken (auth, messaging, realtime)
findings.fix: Add smoke test step to restore runbook: verify auth flow, message send, WebSocket connect, file access

findings.issue: Terraform state has no DR backup plan — DO Spaces bucket has no cross-region replication configured
findings.impact: If DO Spaces bucket is lost, Terraform state is unrecoverable — infrastructure must be rebuilt from scratch
findings.fix: Document Terraform state recovery: import existing resources from cloud provider; consider state bucket replication

findings.issue: SECURITY DEFINER functions missing SET search_path — 4 functions affected
findings.impact: Search_path injection attack: user-created objects can hijack elevated privileges
findings.fix: Add SET search_path = 'public' to handle_new_user(), handle_new_channel(), handle_new_workspace(), and the fixed version in migration 22

findings.issue: Missing INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE RLS policies for workspace_members and channel_members tables
findings.impact: Direct user operations on member tables bypass RLS — relies entirely on application-level middleware
findings.fix: Add INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE policies for workspace_members and channel_members with auth.uid() checks

findings.issue: TypeScript types significantly out of sync with database schema — 6 types defined vs 16 tables exist
findings.impact: Type safety gaps: developers referencing missing types will fall back to any; soft-delete fields (deleted_at, archived_at) missing from Workspace, Channel, Message types
findings.fix: Run npx supabase gen types typescript --local > packages/db/src/types.ts; verify all tables represented

findings.issue: Migration sequence gap in 20260626 batch — jumps from 01 to 22 with 21 missing sequence numbers
findings.impact: Suggests migrations were deleted or renumbered; Supabase CLI tracking by filename may conflict
findings.fix: Audit migration sequence; create placeholder files or renumber to eliminate gaps

findings.issue: Webhook_endpoints.created_by FK has no ON DELETE action — defaults to RESTRICT
findings.impact: Deleting an auth user who created webhooks will fail with FK violation
findings.fix: Add ON DELETE SET NULL or ON DELETE CASCADE to webhook_endpoints.created_by FK constraint

findings.issue: Runbook incorrectly states 'PostgreSQL does not support transactional DDL rollback'
findings.impact: Misguided operator guidance — DDL inside BEGIN/ROLLBACK IS supported, preventing safe rollback
findings.fix: Correct the runbook: PostgreSQL fully supports DDL rollback within transaction blocks

findings.issue: Missing index on reactions.message_id — all reaction queries filter by message_id
findings.impact: Full table scans on reaction queries for channels with many messages and reactions
findings.fix: CREATE INDEX idx_reactions_message_id ON public.reactions(message_id)

findings.issue: Missing index on notifications.workspace_id — workspace-level notification queries
findings.impact: Full table scans for workspace notification listing
findings.fix: CREATE INDEX idx_notifications_workspace_id ON public.notifications(workspace_id)

findings.issue: Seed data contains plaintext webhook secrets visible in repository
findings.impact: Development secrets committed to git — if repository access is compromised, secrets are exposed
findings.fix: Remove hardcoded secrets from seed files; use placeholder values like 'CHANGE_ME'

findings.issue: No down/rollback scripts exist for any of the 26 migrations
findings.impact: Rollback requires manual SQL construction per incident or PITR with data loss
findings.fix: Write .down.sql reversal scripts for each migration, starting with the last 5 additive-column migrations

findings.issue: Dual migration application paths: supabase db execute (dev scripts) vs supabase db push (CI)
findings.impact: Different code paths may produce different results — db push uses migration tracking, db execute runs raw SQL
findings.fix: Standardize on supabase db push for all environments; remove db execute fallback path

findings.issue: No E2E test for the core auth flow (magic link -> callback -> workspace redirect) — all auth tests stubbed/skipped
findings.impact: Cannot detect auth flow regressions in CI — the most critical user journey is untested
findings.fix: Build Tier 1 auth scenario: mock magic link, verify callback redirect, validate session persistence, test workspace list render

findings.issue: No E2E test for workspace create, channel create, or message send flow — core product journey untested
findings.impact: Cannot detect regressions in the primary user action sequence in CI
findings.fix: Build Tier 1 product scenario: create workspace -> create channel -> send message -> verify message appears

findings.issue: No E2E test for cross-tenant isolation — user A cannot see user B's data
findings.impact: Cannot detect tenant isolation regressions — a single regression could expose all data across workspaces
findings.fix: Build Tier 2 authorization scenario: user A creates workspace and data, user B attempts to access — verify 403

findings.issue: No E2E test for message edit and delete workflows
findings.impact: Cannot detect regressions in message update/delete UX
findings.fix: Build Tier 1 messaging scenario: send message -> edit content -> verify update; send -> delete -> verify removal

findings.issue: No E2E test for file upload (image + document)
findings.impact: Upload path regressions undetected until production
findings.fix: Build Tier 2 file upload scenario: upload image, verify preview; upload document, verify download link

findings.issue: No E2E test for real-time message delivery between two browser contexts
findings.impact: Core realtime feature — multi-user message delivery untested in CI
findings.fix: Build Tier 2 realtime scenario: two browser contexts, one sends message, verify other receives it via WebSocket

findings.issue: No E2E test for WebSocket reconnect behavior after disconnect
findings.impact: Reconnect logic untested — messages could be lost during disconnect window
findings.fix: Build Tier 2 reconnect scenario: disconnect socket, reconnect, verify room membership restored and no messages lost

findings.issue: 54 E2E test stubs exist in comprehensive.spec.ts but all are test.skip — effectively zero E2E coverage
findings.impact: 48 test cases defined but none execute in CI; false sense of coverage
findings.fix: Prioritize un-skipping auth, workspace, and message tests with proper test data seeding

findings.issue: No test data factories or fixture files — all test data inlined per test file
findings.impact: Brittle tests; any schema change requires updating multiple test files
findings.fix: Create shared test data factories for users, workspaces, channels, messages

findings.issue: Two Playwright configs exist but only root config (chromium-only) runs in CI — apps/web/e2e/ config with 3 browsers unused
findings.impact: Firefox and WebKit E2E coverage never tested in CI
findings.fix: Consolidate to single Playwright config or add multi-browser execution in CI

findings.issue: Worker package has no test script at all — zero test coverage
findings.impact: Background worker failures undetected by CI
findings.fix: Add vitest configuration and basic worker logic tests

findings.issue: Production Caddyfile missing API subdomain block — chat-api.mainecybertech.com DNS exists but Caddy does not serve it
findings.impact: Direct API access to production API subdomain gets no TLS termination — mysterious connection failures
findings.fix: Add site block for chat-api.mainecybertech.com to Caddyfile.prod, or remove the unused DNS record

findings.issue: Same Terraform state key for both environments — no environment isolation in state key
findings.impact: Dev and prod Terraform operations use the same state — one environment's changes can corrupt the other
findings.fix: Use environment-specific state keys (e.g., infra/terraform/${var.environment}.tfstate)

findings.issue: API env schema and shared config package have 11 variable mismatches (optional vs required, missing vars, name conflicts)
findings.impact: API starts with missing required config; EMAIL_FROM vs SMTP_FROM name collision causes silent fallback
findings.fix: Synchronize env.ts with env-schema.ts; resolve EMAIL_FROM/SMTP_FROM naming; add REDIS_TLS, SENTRY_ENVIRONMENT, VAPID_SUBJECT

findings.issue: SMTP/email env vars not set in any deployment workflow — SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS, EMAIL_FROM all missing
findings.impact: Password reset emails and transactional emails will fail in deployed environments
findings.fix: Add SMTP configuration with SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS, EMAIL_FROM secrets to both deploy workflows

findings.issue: Sentry DSN never set in any deployment — SENTRY_DSN and NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN not configured
findings.impact: Error tracking in deployed environments silently falls back to unconfigured state — no error capture
findings.fix: Add SENTRY_DSN and NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN secrets to both deploy workflows

findings.issue: Dev API subdomain (chat-api.mainecybertech.us) deployed but unused — DNS + Caddy block but nothing uses it
findings.impact: Wasted TLS cert issuance, DNS record, and Caddy config — all API traffic goes through same-domain /v1/* proxy
findings.fix: Remove API subdomain DNS record for development, or document as future architecture option

findings.issue: Web env schema missing 4 validated variables: NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN, NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_VERSION, NEXT_PUBLIC_GIT_SHA, NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_TIME
findings.impact: Version badge always shows '0.0.0-dev' and 'local' in production; Sentry not configured on frontend
findings.fix: Add these vars to apps/web/lib/env.ts Zod schema

findings.issue: Default droplet size is s-1vcpu-512mb-10gb but 512MB is known to cause OOM (documented in AGENTS.md)
findings.impact: Development droplet will run out of memory under normal load
findings.fix: Update default droplet size to s-2vcpu-2gb in terraform variables.tf

findings.issue: Supabase migrations use same SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF for both dev and prod — no separate Supabase project
findings.impact: Migrations applied via develop branch directly affect the same database as main
findings.fix: Use separate Supabase projects for development and production with separate project ref secrets

findings.issue: No frontend feature flag client — flags only available server-side through API
findings.impact: Cannot gate frontend features with feature flags; flag evaluation requires API round-trip
findings.fix: Create frontend feature flag client (or inject flags from server props) for client-side feature gating

findings.issue: Feature flags use in-memory cache per instance — no Redis-backed cache invalidation
findings.impact: Multi-instance deployments see stale flag state up to 60s; flag change on one instance invalidates only that instance's cache
findings.fix: Use Redis pub/sub for cross-instance cache invalidation

findings.issue: Dev Caddyfile lacks static asset caching that prod has — no Cache-Control max-age for static assets
findings.impact: Development environment serves static assets without browser caching — slower local dev experience
findings.fix: Add @static matcher with max-age directive to dev Caddyfile

findings.issue: Push subscription service reads VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY and EMAIL_FROM directly from process.env instead of validated env schema
findings.impact: Env var validation bypassed — missing vars cause silent runtime failures instead of startup errors
findings.fix: Import validated env config instead of reading process.env directly

findings.issue: No chaos testing scripts or tooling exist — zero failure injection capability
findings.impact: System has never been tested under failure conditions; brittle assumptions about degraded behavior are unvalidated
findings.fix: Implement Tier 1 failure tests using unit-level mocking (DB timeout, socket failure, webhook 500) in existing service tests

findings.issue: No E2E test for database unavailable scenario — API should return 503, client should show 'connection lost' state
findings.impact: User-facing degraded state never validated — users may see confusing errors or blank screens
findings.fix: Use Playwright route interception to simulate API 503; verify correct degraded UI is shown

findings.issue: No test for socket disconnect/reconnect behavior — client message queuing and replay on reconnect untested
findings.impact: Messages written during disconnect period may be silently lost
findings.fix: Write integration test: disconnect socket client, send message via API, reconnect, verify message received via socket

findings.issue: Circuit breaker (opossum) is a dependency but has zero test coverage
findings.impact: Circuit breaker logic — open, half-open, recovery — never tested; unexpected behavior in production
findings.fix: Write unit tests for circuit breaker: simulate 50%+ failures, verify open state; simulate recovery, verify half-open

findings.issue: Webhook retry logic, DLQ, and exponential backoff have zero integration test coverage
findings.impact: Retry mechanism may silently fail; DLQ may not capture failed deliveries; backoff may misbehave under load
findings.fix: Write tests: mock webhook endpoint returning 500, verify retry count increments, verify DLQ capture after max retries

findings.issue: No test for rate limiter being hit — client should show 'too many requests' with retry-after header
findings.impact: Rate limiting UX never validated — users may see unhelpful errors or silent failures
findings.fix: Write E2E test: burst requests beyond rate limit, verify 429 status and Retry-After header, verify correct client message

findings.issue: No test for Redis unavailability (for Socket.io adapter) — fallback to in-memory mode untested
findings.impact: If Redis fails, Socket.io may fail entirely or exhibit undefined behavior
findings.fix: Write integration test: start server without Redis, verify Socket.io falls back to in-memory adapter, verify messaging still works

findings.issue: No test for file upload failure (image processing error, oversized file, invalid type)
findings.impact: Upload error UX never validated — users may see confusing errors or hang state
findings.fix: Write E2E test with oversized file, invalid content type, and simulated processing failure; verify appropriate error messages

findings.issue: No test for webhook delivery timeout — circuit breaker open, DLQ capture, and operator notification
findings.impact: Timeout behavior never validated; circuit breaker may not open as expected
findings.fix: Write integration test: mock slow webhook endpoint (>10s), verify timeout, verify circuit breaker opens, verify DLQ capture

findings.issue: No synthetic endpoint for triggering controlled failures (e.g., /debug/fail-webhooks, /debug/slow-db)
findings.impact: Chaos testing requires modifying production services — no safe test harness
findings.fix: Add debug endpoints (guarded by NODE_ENV) for triggering controlled failures in test environments

findings.issue: Unicode/emoji icons used instead of SVG icons — poor contrast and inconsistent rendering across platforms
findings.impact: Accessibility: emoji icons have inconsistent rendering and may not be announced by screen readers consistently
findings.fix: Migrate Unicode icons to lucide-react SVG icons with proper aria-hidden and aria-label attributes

findings.issue: Loading state shows text 'Loading...' instead of skeleton component — inconsistent with rest of app
findings.impact: Poor user experience during loading — no visual placeholder for layout structure
findings.fix: Replace 'Loading...' text with Skeleton component matching workspace layout structure

findings.issue: Focus not returned to hamburger button after closing mobile sidebar via overlay click or Escape
findings.impact: Keyboard users lose context after closing sidebar — focus jumps to unexpected location
findings.fix: Store reference to trigger element and call .focus() after sidebar close

findings.issue: Create workspace trigger uses role='button' on a div with tabIndex=0 instead of native <button>
findings.impact: Not keyboard accessible in all browsers; no native button semantics (Space key may not activate)
findings.fix: Replace div with actual <button> element

findings.issue: Channel list items (Link elements inside role='listbox') lack aria-label identifying them as navigation items
findings.impact: Screen reader users cannot distinguish channel links from other list items
findings.fix: Add aria-label='Navigate to channel {channel.name}' on each channel Link element

findings.issue: Theme toggle button in app header may lack aria-label — ThemeToggle component from @chat/ui needs verification
findings.impact: Screen reader users may not know the theme toggle button's purpose
findings.fix: Ensure ThemeToggle component accepts and propagates aria-label prop

findings.issue: No keyboard shortcut help menu — bulk actions require mouse
findings.impact: Power users cannot learn keyboard shortcuts; no documented shortcut reference
findings.fix: Add Ctrl+/ or ? keyboard shortcut help overlay; document common shortcuts

findings.issue: No i18n/internationalization support — lang='en' hardcoded
findings.impact: Screen reader pronunciation may be wrong for non-English content
findings.fix: Add next-intl or similar i18n library; make lang attribute dynamic

findings.issue: Search results use aria-selected but do not set aria-activedescendant on the search input
findings.impact: Screen reader cursor tracking is imprecise during keyboard navigation of search results
findings.fix: Set aria-activedescendant on the search input pointing to the currently highlighted result

findings.issue: No message pagination in chat-view — fetches all messages at once with no cursor/offset limit
findings.impact: Long channels have unbounded load times and memory consumption
findings.fix: Implement cursor-based pagination: load initial 50 messages, fetch older on scroll-to-top

findings.issue: Typing indicator events not throttled on the server side — only client-side throttle at 2000ms
findings.impact: Rapid typing changes still fire many events; no server-side protection against flooding
findings.fix: Add rate limiting on socket typing:start events server-side; keep client throttle as defense-in-depth

findings.issue: Optimistic messages lack visual distinction (e.g., grayed out) for 'sending' state
findings.impact: Users cannot distinguish between pending (optimistic) and confirmed messages — confusion if message fails
findings.fix: Apply reduced opacity or spinner indicator to optimistic messages; revert on failure with toast error

findings.issue: Thread reply input uses fixed rows={2} — does not auto-resize unlike the main message input
findings.impact: Long thread replies require manual scrolling in the textarea; inconsistent with main message input UX
findings.fix: Replace fixed rows with auto-resize behavior matching message-input.tsx

findings.issue: No icon library — all icons are Unicode/emoji characters throughout the app
findings.impact: Inconsistent cross-platform rendering; no accessibility attributes on emoji icons; no SVG theming
findings.fix: Adopt an icon library (lucide-react recommended) with consistent aria-label and aria-hidden patterns

findings.issue: No typography scale or design tokens for heading/text variants — uses raw Tailwind classes
findings.impact: Inconsistent text sizing across pages; no design system guardrails for typography
findings.fix: Define typography scale tokens in globals.css; create Text and Heading components

findings.issue: Raw opacity values used directly (opacity-50, opacity-70, etc.) — no design tokens
findings.impact: Inconsistent transparency patterns across components
findings.fix: Define semantic opacity tokens (--opacity-disabled, --opacity-subtle, --opacity-overlay)

findings.issue: Notification dropdown lacks max-height — long notification lists extend beyond viewport
findings.impact: Users with many notifications cannot scroll within the dropdown; notifications overflow below viewport
findings.fix: Add max-h-96 overflow-y-auto to notification dropdown container

findings.issue: Reply-to bar shows only 'Replying to [name]' without preview of the replied-to message content
findings.impact: Users must remember or scroll to find the original message they're replying to
findings.fix: Add truncated preview of the replied-to message content below the name in the reply bar

findings.issue: Search results don't highlight the matched query terms in the excerpt
findings.impact: Users cannot quickly see why a result matched their search query
findings.fix: Highlight matching query terms in search result snippets using <mark> or bold

findings.issue: Message actions (reply, react, edit, delete) are hidden until hover — opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100
findings.impact: On touch devices or with mouse-free navigation, message actions are not visible
findings.fix: Show message actions always on mobile/touch; keep hover-with-focus pattern for desktop

findings.issue: No shared ButtonGroup component — login form mode toggle (Sign In/Sign Up) uses manually styled buttons
findings.impact: Inconsistent button group styling; no reusable pattern for segmented controls
findings.fix: Create shared ButtonGroup component with active state styling

findings.issue: All pages use 'use client' directive — zero server components — full JS bundle downloaded on every route
findings.impact: No React Server Component benefits: no streaming SSR, larger initial JS payload, slower time-to-interactive
findings.fix: Convert non-interactive sections (landing page, workspace list) to server components; use 'use client' only where interactivity requires it

findings.issue: No route-level code splitting — all components eagerly imported via static imports
findings.impact: Large components (ChatView, ThreadPanel, SettingsPage) bundled into main chunk — slower initial load
findings.fix: Use next/dynamic for lazy-loading heavy components: ChatView, ThreadPanel, SettingsPage

findings.issue: No virtual list for long transcripts — all messages rendered as flat DOM nodes
findings.impact: Channels with thousands of messages cause full DOM rendering; unbounded memory growth; long session performance degrades
findings.fix: Implement virtual scrolling with react-window or @tanstack/react-virtual for message list

findings.issue: Reaction data fetched for ALL visible messages on every messages change — N+1 query pattern
findings.impact: Each message render triggers a batch reaction fetch; with 50 visible messages per page, significant overhead
findings.fix: Cache reaction data by message ID; only re-fetch when new messages appear in viewport

findings.issue: Avatar image uses instead of Next.js — no lazy loading or responsive images
findings.impact: Avatar images block initial load; no automatic srcset generation for responsive sizes
findings.fix: Replace with Next.js component with lazy loading

findings.issue: Socket.io client imported eagerly even on pages that don't need real-time (workspace overview, settings)
findings.impact: ~50KB socket.io client JS loaded on every page regardless of whether real-time features are used
findings.fix: Dynamic import socket.io client only on pages that require real-time features

findings.issue: All messages stored in single flat array — no pagination, windowing, or pruning of old messages
findings.impact: Long chat sessions accumulate unbounded memory; page grows slower over time
findings.fix: Limit in-memory message store to last N messages (e.g., 500); implement cursor-based load on scroll

findings.issue: transpilePackages: ['@chat/ui'] increases build time
findings.impact: Every pnpm build transpiles the shared UI package — necessary but can be optimized
findings.fix: Consider building @chat/ui as pre-compiled package to reduce transpilation overhead

findings.issue: No deploy-time audit gating for production — deploy-production.yml runs without evaluating gate-policy.prod.json
findings.impact: P0/P1 findings can reach production with zero governance gate — the entire policy gating system is advisory
findings.fix: Add evaluate_gate.py step to deploy-production.yml before docker compose up, using gate-policy.prod.json with fail-on-violation

findings.issue: governance.yml and platform.yml workflows are broken on every push — call run_full.ps1 referencing 5 nonexistent scripts
findings.impact: CI noise on every push; no actual governance enforcement from these workflows
findings.fix: Fix or disable governance.yml and platform.yml; consolidate into working evaluate_gate.py invocations

findings.issue: Hotfix policy special_requirements (executive_signoff_required, rollback_plan_required, post_release_validation_required) are not enforced by any script
findings.impact: Hotfix policy is functionally identical to RC — three compensating controls are documented but never checked
findings.fix: Implement special_requirements enforcement in evaluate_gate.py and evaluate_promotion_gate.py

findings.issue: audit-pr-gate.yml uses dev policy for ALL PRs — PRs targeting main should use RC or prod policy
findings.impact: PRs to production branch evaluated against permissive dev thresholds (max_p1=5 instead of max_p1=0)
findings.fix: Make audit-pr-gate.yml policy file selection aware of target branch: dev-policy for develop, rc-policy for release/*, prod-policy for main

findings.issue: Duplicate policy file sets exist (hardening_super_bundle/policies/ and docs/audits/policies/) — risk of drift
findings.impact: Policy changes made to one set may not be reflected in the other — inconsistent gating
findings.fix: Consolidate to single source of truth (recommend hardening/policies/) with symlinks or CI sync check

findings.issue: Branch protection checks exist but only read-check and warn — no enforced required status checks on main
findings.impact: PRs can merge to main without passing audit gates, lint, or tests — no CI enforcement
findings.fix: Enforce branch protection via Terraform github_branch_protection resource or GitHub API; make audit-gate a required check

findings.issue: No approval process for policy file changes — any PR can silently relax gate thresholds
findings.impact: Developers can bypass governance by relaxing thresholds without review
findings.fix: Add CODEOWNERS for hardening/policies/* and hardening/rules/* requiring senior engineer approval

findings.issue: Hotfix gate not wired to any workflow — gate-policy.hotfix.json exists but no workflow references it
findings.impact: Hotfix tier is defined but unused; emergencies follow production path with no hotfix-specific controls
findings.fix: Create hotfix/* branch workflow with hotfix-policy; implement expedited deploy path with compensating controls

findings.issue: RC gate not wired to any workflow — gate-policy.rc.json exists but no workflow evaluates it
findings.impact: Release candidate tier is defined but completely unused in CI
findings.fix: Add RC evaluation to release branch PRs or a pre-deploy gate in the release workflow

findings.issue: No policy versioning or schema validation — policy files are ad-hoc JSON with no schema enforcement
findings.impact: Invalid policy entries may be silently ignored; no backward compatibility validation
findings.fix: Add JSON schema for policy files; add version field; validate policy format in CI

findings.issue: Exceptions.json is always empty — no historical exception tracking
findings.impact: Cannot audit how often policy gates were bypassed or what waivers were granted
findings.fix: Populate exceptions.json from PR audit gate overrides; add exception review workflow

findings.issue: No policy inheritance mechanism — each tier policy file is a full copy instead of extending a base
findings.impact: Policy changes must be duplicated across 4 files; risk of inconsistency
findings.fix: Implement base-policy.json with tier-specific overrides; merge at evaluation time

findings.description: No sending indicator on optimistic messages
Missing tablet breakpoint in chat layout

findings.issue: Existing k6 load tests only hit / and /healthz endpoints — no real API endpoints tested at all
findings.impact: Load tests provide no insight into actual system behavior under load — false sense of load-readiness
findings.fix: Replace k6 test scripts with meaningful scenarios: message send, workspace/channel listing, search, WebSocket connect

findings.issue: k6 is not invoked in any CI workflow — load tests exist but never run
findings.impact: No load regression detection in CI — performance degradation goes unnoticed until production
findings.fix: Add k6 smoke test (1 VU, 30s) to validate.yml; add full load test as nightly workflow

findings.issue: No WebSocket load test: concurrent socket connections, message send, and message delivery latency
findings.impact: Realtime system behavior under load completely unknown — socket fanout could become bottleneck
findings.fix: Build k6 WebSocket scenario: 50+ concurrent connections, each sending messages, measure p50/p95/p99 delivery latency

findings.issue: No search load test — concurrent search queries with varied terms
findings.impact: Full-text search performance under load unknown — could cause DB CPU spikes
findings.fix: Build k6 search scenario: concurrent search queries with varied terms, measure response time, verify result accuracy

findings.issue: No notification fanout load test — one message triggering notifications for many members
findings.impact: Notification delivery latency under load unknown — push notification queue could back up
findings.fix: Build k6 scenario: one message triggers notification for 100 members, measure notification delivery latency

findings.issue: No reconnect storm load test — all sockets disconnect simultaneously
findings.impact: Reconnect behavior under stress unknown — server may not handle simultaneous reconnection
findings.fix: Build k6 scenario: 100+ concurrent sockets, disconnect all, measure reconnect time and message recovery

findings.issue: 18 Prometheus metrics defined but not consumed by k6 thresholds — k6 checks don't reference metrics
findings.impact: Cannot set metric-based pass/fail thresholds in load tests
findings.fix: Add metric endpoint polling to k6 test thresholds (error rate < 1%, p95 latency < 2000ms)

findings.issue: No capacity assumptions or success criteria documented for any load scenario
findings.impact: Cannot determine if load test results are acceptable — no baseline for comparison
findings.fix: Document expected capacity: max concurrent users, message rate, notification throughput; set k6 thresholds accordingly

findings.issue: k6 not declared as devDependency — requires separate CLI install
findings.impact: Load testing setup friction — no standard version pinned across team
findings.fix: Add k6 as devDependency or add Docker-based k6 runner script

findings.issue: No load test report artifact published in CI
findings.impact: Load test results not visible in PRs or dashboards — no trend tracking
findings.fix: Add k6 report output as CI artifact; consider Grafana k6 integration for dashboard

findings.issue: No application-level alerting configured — no error rate, latency, auth failure, or health check alerts
findings.impact: Production incidents detected only when users report them — no proactive notification of system degradation
findings.fix: Configure Sentry alert rules for error threshold breaches and PagerDuty/Slack integration; add Prometheus alert rules

findings.issue: No external uptime monitoring service configured — no Pingdom, Checkly, Better Uptime, or UptimeRobot
findings.impact: Complete downtime is only detected when users report it or Docker HEALTHCHECK notices locally — no external view
findings.fix: Add free-tier uptime monitoring (UptimeRobot or Better Uptime) that checks /healthz every 5 minutes

findings.issue: DigitalOcean alerts (CPU>80%, Memory>80%, Disk>90%) only go to email — no PagerDuty, Slack, or SMS integration
findings.impact: Critical infrastructure alerts may be missed if email notifications are not monitored promptly
findings.fix: Add Slack webhook or PagerDuty integration to DO monitoring alerts

findings.issue: No automatic request logging middleware — every log line must include request context manually
findings.impact: Inconsistent log context; some requests produce no access log; correlation requires manual context passing
findings.fix: Add auto-request-logging middleware that captures method, path, status code, duration, and request ID for every request

findings.issue: No distributed tracing — only basic request IDs, no OpenTelemetry, span propagation, or trace correlation across services
findings.impact: Cannot trace a single user action across API -> DB -> WebSocket -> webhook; debugging complex failures requires manual log correlation
findings.fix: Add OpenTelemetry instrumentation for Express, database queries, and external HTTP calls

findings.issue: No log shipping or aggregation — logs are local Docker container stdout; no Papertrail, Logtail, Axiom, or Loki
findings.impact: No centralized log search; logs lost on container restart; cannot alert on log patterns
findings.fix: Add Docker log driver to send logs to a cloud log aggregation service; or add logagent sidecar

findings.issue: 18 Prometheus metrics exposed but no remote collector, dashboard, or alert rules consume them
findings.impact: Metrics are generated and exposed but never visualized or alerted on — observability gap
findings.fix: Set up Grafana dashboard consuming API /metrics endpoint; define alert rules for error rate and latency

findings.issue: Frontend has no structured logging — console.log/error used ad-hoc
findings.impact: Client-side issues cannot be diagnosed from logs; no structured frontend telemetry
findings.fix: Add frontend logging library (e.g., loglevel) with remote log shipping for production errors

findings.issue: Audit event queue is in-memory — lost on process restart; no Redis-backed persistence
findings.impact: Audit events during restart window are lost; compliance gap for sensitive operations
findings.fix: Replace in-memory queue with Redis-backed persistent queue or write directly with retry

findings.issue: Health checks only validate database connectivity — no check for Redis, Supabase Storage, or external service availability
findings.impact: Health check can pass while critical dependencies (Redis, Storage) are down
findings.fix: Add dependency checks for Redis (if configured), Supabase Storage connectivity, and circuit breaker states

findings.issue: No business metrics dashboard — active users, messages/day, workspace growth not visualized anywhere
findings.impact: Business stakeholders lack visibility into platform growth and adoption
findings.fix: Create Grafana dashboard with business metrics: daily active users, messages/day, workspaces created, reactions

findings.issue: No audit event for read operations (SELECT queries) — only mutation events are logged
findings.impact: Unauthorized read access to sensitive data leaves no audit trail
findings.fix: Add audit logging for read operations on sensitive data (user search, workspace member list, audit log views)

findings.issue: Production deploy runs docker system prune -af --volumes and docker image prune -af before health check succeeds
findings.impact: Previous SHA-tagged images (needed for rollback) are destroyed before the current deploy is verified. If deploy fails, there is nothing to roll back to.
findings.fix: Move docker prune steps to AFTER successful health check; or use timestamp-based pruning that preserves at least the previous release's SHA images

findings.issue: Rollback job has needs: build-images — triggers unnecessary image build before rollback can execute
findings.impact: Rollback delayed by 20+ minutes (unnecessary image build) while production is degraded
findings.fix: Change rollback job needs to [provision] only — rollback pulls existing SHA images without building new ones

findings.issue: Production version badge build-args (NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_VERSION, NEXT_PUBLIC_GIT_SHA, NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_TIME) not passed
findings.impact: Production always shows 'v0.0.0-dev' and 'local' — operators cannot identify which version is running without inspecting GHCR tags
findings.fix: Add NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_VERSION=${{ github.ref_name }}-${{ github.run_number }}, NEXT_PUBLIC_GIT_SHA, NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_TIME build-args to web Docker build step

findings.issue: No database down/rollback scripts exist for any of the 26 migrations
findings.impact: Forward-fix is the only path for migration issues; PITR causes data loss for the entire database
findings.fix: Write down scripts (.down.sql) for each migration, starting with the 5 ALTER TABLE migrations (#14, #15, #16) that add columns

findings.issue: No rollback job exists for development environment — always deploys latest origin/develop
findings.impact: Broken develop deploy requires manual SSH intervention; no automated recovery path
findings.fix: Add workflow_dispatch with rollback_sha input to deploy-development.yml matching production pattern

findings.issue: Feature flags exist in database but are not wired to any application code — 5 seed flags control nothing
findings.impact: In an emergency, there is no kill-switch mechanism to disable features (push notifications, realtime, file upload)
findings.fix: Audit all feature boundaries and add featureFlagService.evaluateFlag() checks; implement global kill-switch flag

findings.issue: Post-rollback validation only checks /healthz HTTP 200 — no functional smoke tests
findings.impact: Rollback can pass health check while critical features (auth, messaging, realtime) are still broken
findings.fix: Add smoke-test step after rollback: send test message via API, verify WebSocket connect, check auth flow

findings.issue: Migration rollback runbook incorrectly states PostgreSQL does not support DDL rollback
findings.impact: Operators may not attempt safe DDL rollback (BEGIN; ... ROLLBACK;) thinking it's impossible
findings.fix: Correct the runbook: PostgreSQL fully supports DDL rollback within transaction blocks

findings.issue: Development deploy runbook has no rollback section at all
findings.impact: Operators lack documented recovery steps for failed development deployments
findings.fix: Add rollback section to development-deploy-overview.md referencing the production rollback pattern

findings.issue: Circuit breaker implemented but not wired to any feature flag or kill-switch
findings.impact: Circuit breaker opens silently on external dependency failure but no kill-switch mechanism exists to manually disable the failing integration
findings.fix: Wire circuit breaker state to feature flag evaluation so operators can manually disable failing integrations

findings.issue: No git tags or semver releases — only git SHAs identify releases
findings.impact: Cannot easily reference known-good states; no release notes; git describe falls back to bare SHA
findings.fix: Add git tag (e.g., vYYYYMMDD-runNumber) at end of deploy-production.yml; create release notes

findings.issue: Rollback readiness checklists exist in docs/ but are not referenced by any workflow or runbook
findings.impact: Checklists are undiscoverable during incident response
findings.fix: Reference rollback_readiness_checklist.md from production-deploy-overview.md and incident-response.md

findings.issue: No auth on users route
findings.impact: Full data access
findings.fix: Add requireAuth

findings.issue: Users search endpoint missing requireOrgAccess
findings.impact: Authenticated users can search across all tenants
findings.fix: Add requireOrgAccess middleware to search route

findings.issue: CSP missing frame-ancestors directive
findings.impact: Clickjacking risk on all pages
findings.fix: Add frame-ancestors 'self' to CSP header

findings.issue: Magic link email not normalized before send
findings.impact: user@Example.com and user@example.com treated differently
findings.fix: Lowercase email before sending magic link

findings.issue: /metrics endpoint is completely unauthenticated — exposes request counts, durations, WS connections, DB query durations
findings.impact: Anyone can access internal metrics — information disclosure of system topology, traffic patterns, and performance data
findings.fix: Add authenticate middleware to /metrics route or restrict to internal network

findings.issue: Reaction service uses getSupabase() (anon client) — bypasses RLS entirely for all reaction CRUD
findings.impact: Any authenticated user can add/remove reactions on any message in any workspace — no tenant isolation
findings.fix: Replace getSupabase() with req.supabase (JWT client) in reactions/service.ts for all operations

findings.issue: 4 SECURITY DEFINER functions missing SET search_path — search_path injection vulnerability
findings.impact: User with CREATE privilege can create malicious objects that hijack these functions' elevated privileges
findings.fix: Add SET search_path = 'public' to all SECURITY DEFINER function definitions

findings.issue: Message search uses getSupabase() (anon client) — auth.uid() is NULL in SECURITY INVOKER search function
findings.impact: Search function cannot verify user membership — cross-tenant data leakage or no results returned
findings.fix: Replace getSupabase() with req.supabase on messages/routes.ts line 38

findings.issue: Webhook HMAC signature uses JSON.stringify with non-deterministic property ordering
findings.impact: Receivers cannot verify the HMAC signature as JSON.stringify property order is not guaranteed
findings.fix: Use a deterministic serialization method (e.g., object key sorting) before HMAC computation

findings.issue: CI/CD secrets written to disk via inline echo commands — GitHub Actions masking can fail
findings.impact: If shell fails in specific ways, secrets (origin TLS cert, private key, etc.) could appear in logs
findings.fix: Use GitHub Actions environment file ($GITHUB_ENV) or secret files instead of echo; or use docker secret injection

findings.issue: Workspace member management (add/remove/update role) lacks admin/owner role check — any member can manage members
findings.impact: Any workspace member can add, remove, or change roles of other members — privilege escalation
findings.fix: Add admin/owner role check in POST/PATCH/DELETE workspace member routes

findings.issue: Webhook secret stored in plaintext in database and returned in API responses to all workspace members
findings.impact: Workspace members can read webhook secrets — if a webhook is used for CI/CD triggers, full CI pipeline access
findings.fix: Encrypt webhook secret at rest (pgcrypto); mask secret in API responses

findings.issue: Socket.io has allowEIO3: true enabling Engine.IO v3 legacy protocol
findings.impact: Expanded attack surface — Engine.IO v3 has known vulnerabilities and fewer security features
findings.fix: Set allowEIO3: false unless backward compatibility is required

findings.issue: Auth redirect URL uses window.location.origin without validation or allowlist
findings.impact: Open redirect vulnerability — attacker could craft a login URL that redirects to a malicious site after auth
findings.fix: Validate redirectTo against an allowlist of known origins before using

findings.issue: isWorkspaceMember helper uses getSupabase() (anon client) without user JWT context
findings.impact: Membership check bypasses RLS — could return incorrect results or be bypassed
findings.fix: Pass per-request Supabase client to isWorkspaceMember instead of using global anon client

findings.issue: User email logged in workspace list operations — PII exposure in logs
findings.impact: User email addresses exposed in structured logs — potential PII breach in log aggregation
findings.fix: Remove userEmail from log metadata; log only userId where needed

findings.issue: Auth and search rate limiters key by IP only — not user+IP composite
findings.impact: Multiple users behind same NAT share rate limit bucket; single attacker with rotating IPs bypasses limits
findings.fix: Use composite key {userId + ip} when user is authenticated, fall back to IP only for unauthenticated

findings.issue: CSP includes 'unsafe-inline' for styles and allows cdn.jsdelivr.net for scripts
findings.impact: Inline styles enable CSS-based data exfiltration; jsdelivr CDN allows any script from that domain
findings.fix: Use nonce-based CSP for inline styles; restrict CDN allowlist to specific known script paths

findings.issue: CSRF cookie has httpOnly: false (by design for SPA) — any XSS can exfiltrate the token
findings.impact: If XSS is present, CSRF protection is completely bypassed
findings.fix: Consider additional CSRF measures like origin/referer header checking alongside double-submit cookie

findings.issue: No Socket.io rate limiting — channel:join, typing:start/stop events not rate-limited
findings.impact: Malicious client can flood server with socket events, impacting all users
findings.fix: Add per-socket rate limiting for chat events (e.g., max 10 typing events per 5 seconds)

findings.issue: Avatar upload and retrieval routes use getSupabase() (anon client) — storage RLS bypassed
findings.impact: Storage operations may not have proper RLS context — potential unauthorized access
findings.fix: Use getSupabaseAdmin() for avatar upload, req.supabase for avatar retrieval

findings.issue: Feature flag service uses getSupabaseAdmin() for all operations including reads
findings.impact: Regular users cannot be prevented from accessing feature flags at DB level — overprivileged reads
findings.fix: Use req.supabase for reads, getSupabaseAdmin() only for writes

findings.issue: GDPR delete does not clean up audit_logs or consent_logs for the deleted user
findings.impact: User's audit trail and consent records remain after GDPR deletion request — compliance gap
findings.fix: Add cascade or explicit deletion of audit_logs and consent_logs in the GDPR delete endpoint

findings.issue: Trivy vulnerability scanner uses @master tag — mutable reference
findings.impact: Supply chain risk — unpinned action version could introduce breaking changes or malicious code
findings.fix: Pin trivy-action to a specific SHA or semver tag

findings.issue: CSP lacks nonce-based protection for inline scripts
findings.impact: Any injected <script> tag executes in older browsers without CSP enforcement
findings.fix: Implement nonce-based CSP for inline script tags

findings.issue: wget installed in production Docker image — unnecessary package increases attack surface
findings.impact: Extra package in runtime image could be used as attack vector
findings.fix: Remove wget from production Dockerfile; use curl or built-in health check mechanism

findings.issue: console.error in auth callback exposes errors client-side in browser console
findings.impact: Auth errors visible to end users in browser dev tools
findings.fix: Replace console.error with silent logging or Sentry capture

findings.issue: No webhook event type allowlist — any event string accepted
findings.impact: Invalid or unexpected event types could trigger webhooks unnecessarily
findings.fix: Add Zod enum validation for supported event types

findings.issue: pnpm audit threshold set to moderate — high/critical advisories below threshold won't block CI
findings.impact: High-severity dependency vulnerabilities may not block deployment
findings.fix: Raise pnpm audit threshold to high to at minimum block high-severity issues

findings.issue: No visual regression testing tooling of any kind installed — no Percy, Chromatic, Playwright snapshots, or Applitools
findings.impact: UI regressions reach production undetected — every deploy risks visual breakage with zero automated detection
findings.fix: Install Playwright's built-in visual comparison (await expect(page).toHaveScreenshot()) — no extra dependencies needed

findings.issue: No screenshot baselines for any of the 4 critical screens: login form, workspace main view, channel view, settings page
findings.impact: Visual regression on the most-visited screens goes undetected
findings.fix: Add Playwright visual snapshot tests for login form (desktop + mobile), workspace with sidebar + channel list, and message area

findings.issue: No dark mode visual regression coverage — contrast issues in dark theme go undetected
findings.impact: Dark mode UI can degrade without detection — poor user experience for dark mode users
findings.fix: Add dark mode snapshots for all critical screens by toggling class='dark' on html element before screenshot

findings.issue: No mobile/tablet viewport snapshots — responsive layout regressions undetected
findings.impact: Mobile users may see broken layouts without automated detection
findings.fix: Add Playwright snapshot tests at 375px (mobile) and 768px (tablet) viewport widths for critical screens

findings.issue: No visual diff CI job — screenshot comparison not part of any workflow
findings.impact: Visual regression tests exist (if created) but never execute in CI
findings.fix: Add visual-diff step to E2E CI job with configurable sensitivity threshold (0.1% pixel difference)

findings.issue: No snapshot coverage for empty/loading/error states across any component or page
findings.impact: Edge case UI regressions (empty state, error display, loading skeleton) go undetected
findings.fix: Add snapshot tests for: empty workspace list, empty channel list, empty message area, loading skeleton states, 404 page, error display

findings.issue: No snapshot coverage for notification dropdown, thread panel, or file upload preview
findings.impact: Secondary UI surface regressions undetected
findings.fix: Add snapshot tests for notification dropdown (populated + empty), thread panel with replies, file upload preview

findings.issue: No Storybook installation — no component development environment for visual testing
findings.impact: Component-level visual testing requires full page renders; no isolated component snapshot capability
findings.fix: Consider adding Storybook for component-level visual regression with Chromatic

findings.issue: No screenshot baseline update mechanism documented
findings.impact: Intentional UI changes require manual baseline replacement — no workflow to approve new baselines
findings.fix: Document baseline update process: CI generates diff report, reviewer approves, new baseline committed
